title: 🎉 NeuroKit wins a SIPS Mission Award
summary: The NeuroKit Python package has won a Mission Award from the Society for the Improvement of Psychological Science (SIPS).
content: The NeuroKit Python package has won a Mission Award from the Society for the Improvement of Psychological Science (SIPS).

NeuroKit is an open-source toolbox for processing physiological signals (ECG, EDA, EMG, respiration and more), built to make robust neurophysiological analysis accessible without a bioengineering background. The award recognises its contribution to open, reproducible science.
A great recognition for a project that keeps growing thanks to its community of users and contributors.
